label: employed and commissioned by
notes: Fourteen years licensing the crossings his own findings would end. The Wardenry paid for the re-levelling that produced the survey, which makes him an institutional impossibility: the Fourth Article says the Wardenry shall pay the finder, and it has never been invoked where the finder was a Warden. If Denet is the finder, the Wardenry owes itself. Nobody at Bell Harrow knows what that means, including the people who will invoke it.
